links.comparator_used: standalone uncertainty estimation using only the variance of prediction probability
links.outcome: Model reliability / prediction uncertainty estimation for lymph node metastasis in rectal cancer
links.effect: No significant advantage of the human-in-the-loop estimate (variance plus quantified agreement between attention maps and physician understanding) over variance alone; no numbers given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Superficial explanations could do more harm than good by misleading physicians into relying on uncertain predictions.
links.quote: Our findings revealed no significant advantage of the human-in-the-loop approach over the standalone one.

design_hint: human-in-the-loop uncertainty estimation using physician-aligned attention maps
